subject: [hw] opus-venc -> V34: ION_SYS_CACHE_SYNC must copy guest<->device (the session fails without it); exact text in fakevenc/apply_patches.py
body: In sh_ion_custom_ioctl, cmd 0 sub 0 (ION_SYS_CACHE_SYNC, struct ion_sys_cache_sync_param in mtk ion_drv.h:88: handle @8, va @12, size @16, sync_type @20 in the 32-bit ion_sys_data) is answered with 0 and no work. The daemon writes SPS/PPS with the CPU into the imported bitstream buffer and flushes (h264_enc_encode_Header drv 0x134cc8 -> VENC_FlushRangeForIon), and invalidates the bitstream before reading it after the hardware (VENC_gceEncodeEnd oal 0x21c56). The AP then syncs from_device and wipes the header: h264_check FAILS (seq-hdr bytes are zeros). Fix (tested, V34 suite 2035/2035 with it): look up the handle; gbase from n2vc_dma_lookup_handle (weak); off/len from va/size when sync_type < 6 (by range), else whole buffer; n2vc_dma_sync(n2shim_hw, c->mem, gbase, off, len, to_device = !(type==1||type==4||type==7)). Declare n2vc_dma_lookup_handle and n2vc_dma_sync weak (your unit test links without V41). Your foreign ion_free/munmap is already in the tree and is what I needed there.
